# Pulsus Quality

> Quality management software for multi-site organisations: phone inspections, findings with owners and deadlines, verified corrective actions, recurring defects.

This is the official website of Pulsus Quality: https://aboutquality.pulsus.tech/
Pulsus Quality is part of the Pulsus Intelligence Suite (https://about.pulsus.tech/), made by Tumblehill Labs, a product studio of Tumblehill Holdings LLC. It works on its own.

## What it is

Pulsus Quality is quality management and defect tracking software. It brings your quality reviews into one place. Inspectors carry out reviews on a phone; supervisors approve them. You see the defect, resolution and recurring rates for every site and process area, an Operational Standard scorecard you set up yourself, and a register of corrective and preventive actions followed through to a verified close.

## Key features

- Pulse: Defect, resolution and recurring rates
- Register: Every figure, and where it came from
- Reviews: On a phone, with an approval queue
- Insights: Watchlist, resolution gap, repeats
- Actions: Corrective and preventive, verified
- Executive report: Prints to PDF, with exports

## Price

- $500 a month, including 5 users; extra users are $50 each a month. For a larger organisation, talk to us.
- Prices in US dollars, as shown on the plans page: https://aboutquality.pulsus.tech/plans/
- 14-day free trial, no card needed.
